recipes.name: Campbell's Kitchen Chicken Broccoli Divan
ingredients_raw: 1 pound fresh broccoli, cut into spears
1.5 cups cubed cooked chicken or turkey
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Broccoli Cheese Soup or Campbell's® Condensed 98% Fat Free Broccoli Cheese Soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C).

Arrange broccoli and cooked chicken in a 2-quart shallow baking dish or 9-inch pie plate. Stir together condensed soup and milk in a medium bowl until combined, then pour over all. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix together bread crumbs and melted butter in a small bowl; sprinkle on top.
Bake casserole in the preheated oven until hot, about 25 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Campbell's Kitchen Chicken Broccoli Divan
raw_recipe.description: This Campbell's chicken and broccoli casserole features cooked meat, condensed soup, and Cheddar cheese baked with a buttery bread crumb topping.

review.reviewBody: I have been making this recipes for years. It's one of my favorites!! The only difference is that I use frozen broccoli spears.

Love chicken divan and I hate to gild the lily in a great recipe but here I am doing it. I hate Mayo/sour cream so I use unflavored yogurt instead. I do not add milk. Instead I add two cans of cream of chicken soup and a tablespoon of lemon juice. I’m a cheddar cheese addict, so I add 1/2 cup of it into the soup mixture and 1/2 to the top. Corn flake crumbs are my preference over bread crumbs.

Excellent! I first layered two pouches of already cooked brown and wild rice medley to the bottom of the 9x13 baking dish. Then doubled the recipe and used 1 can of broccoli cheese mixed with 1 can of cream of mushroom with a little garlic powder, pepper, and smoked paprika; I used whole milk. And instead of just adding broccoli, I used frozen mixed vegetables that included broccoli, cauliflower and carrots, which had been thawed slightly under cool water. I used a bit more cheese (sharp cheddar) than called for because we love it! I tripled the crumb topping (instead of doubling) and perhaps next time will add more, as dh thought it really added a delicious final touch. We think the Italian Style Panko makes for a crunchier topping than other similar seasoned crumbs. It went into the oven for 30 minutes at 400 degrees and came out delicious! This easy recipe is joining the dinner rotation. :)

I've been making this since I was a newly-wed, 30 years ago, and I have made changes along the way. 1) I use Campbell's Cheddar soup without the mushy broccoli, 2) sub cauliflower or mix with broccoli, 3) add extra spices such as smoked paprika, basil and onion powder. It is a good stand by to have when I'm in a pinch for dinner! Was recently asked for the recipe, so that's a good sign.

This was simple to make, and enjoyed by all..... Even my broccoli-hating son managed to finish his portion! It lost a star because of 2 things from the original recipe....... 1) One can of soup definitely does not go far enough! Use 2 cans, with appropriate proportions of milk to thin it. 2) As so many reviewers commented that it was bland, I added garlic.... 1 tsp mixed in with the 2 cans of soup, before putting it in the casserole dish. Last note: I used frozen broccoli, as this is easier, and avoided complaints about under-done broccoli.

I used closer to 3 cups of chicken and added 2 packages of Rice a Roni broccoli and cheese flavor (already made) and an extra 1/3 cup milk. I used frozen broccoli and just mixed it in still frozen. I also used French's fried onions instead of bread crumbs cause that's all I had. Tunred out very good. Will make again.

Really easy recipe for a quick dinner. I finely chopped the cooked broccoli and combined the chicken, broccoli, soup, and milk before adding to the pan. This gave the mixture a chance to "cook" for a few minutes so that it could thicken & not be runny/soupy. Instead of using breadcrumbs, I used crushed up Kellogs Corn Flakes cereal. This added a nice crunch to the top of the mix, which my family loved! Definitely recommend. Served w/ rice to make it more of a meal.
Using the broccoli raw it comes out undercooked. I recommend steaming it for a few minutes before putting it in the casserole
Excellent recipe! Instead of boiling the chicken, I sauted it in olive oil. I used frozen broccoli and steamed it before putting it in the pie pan. I will definately be making this again!

This is one of those dishes I remember from growing up. I did make some slight changes; I cooked the chicken breasts in the oven, boiled chicken not very appealing. Used frozen broccoli that I par cooked in the microwave, also used cream of chicken soup because that is what I had on hand(will try with the broccoli cheddar soup next time). I also added a pinch of nutmeg, you can't really taste it but it adds a little something.

I’ve made this SO many times when we want a creamy cheesy meal. Comes out great every time! Sometimes I add rice to the mix. You can use any of the Campbell’s cream of broccoli, cheese, chicken or mushroom soups. I pan fry seasoned cubed chicken breast and throw on top of frozen broccoli florets then top with soup mixture, cheese and bread crumb mixture.
Great recipe for kids. I served with elbow noodles and used fried onions on top.
I added sauteed mushrooms, onions and corn. Will make again. Love that it doesn't have any rice or pasta. Healthier for hubby.
Easy To Make Great Flavor Definitely A Winner In My House
I've made this Chicken Broccoli Divan a few times in the past. Husband and I love it! Tastes good on top of baked potatoes or rice.

This is a wonderful recipe. Fun additions: sliced water chestnuts (!) in the mix for crunch, sliced fresh mushrooms in the mix, and French's (or whomever) crispy onions on top mixed with the breadcrumbs and cheese.

This is a family favorite, with some changes. We typically double the recipe, triple the cheese, breadcrumbs and butter. I add more flavor with salt, pepper, garlic, onion powder, Italian seasonings, and paprika. I also use cream of chicken with herbs for some additional added flavor. Super yummy.
I found this recipe on the back of Campbells can 35 years ago and have been making it for my family ever since. One of my families fave meals. It's addictive delish.

I have made this for years and serve this over white rice. My two cheats to make it easier are using canned chicken (Costco’s Kirkland brand or Sam’s Club Member’s Mark canned chicken) and frozen broccoli (thawed or cooked until firm), gets it in the oven quick! This casserole always gets raves!!

Came out pretty yummy. I knew raw broccoli would not work so I streamed it with a half a red pepper cause I like color and flavor. Chopped both up and spread in greased glass pie plate. I also sliced up some fresh mushroom because I had one the layered on top. Use the breast-meat from the rotisserie chicken from Sam's. Used Campbell Healthy Request Cheese Soup so it’s not salty. And sprinkled Mozzarella on top cause it’s what I had. 😋
